content.value: Hold Use to draw. Press Attack while drawing to shoot; release Use to lower the bow without firing or consuming an arrow. Keeping Use held after a shot starts the next draw. Each Attack press fires once.
Hold Use to reload. Releasing before loading completes cancels the reload and resets its progress. Loading completes while Use is held.

Once loaded, release Use and press it again to aim with a 20% field-of-view reduction. Finishing a reload does not zoom automatically. Press Attack to fire the loaded projectile; an unloaded Attack remains melee.
Keeping Use held after firing starts the next reload. The firing animation is allowed to finish first. Holding Attack does not repeatedly fire.

The arrow-shaped charge indicator follows the same draw or reload clock as gameplay. Attack-speed bonuses change that timing. Player arrow damage follows the weapon and bow draw strength, not random vanilla arrow-critical bonuses or impact speed.

RPG [[article/damage#critical_strikes|critical strikes]], elemental damage and target defences still apply. Projectile Speed changes flight speed without secretly multiplying player bow or crossbow damage.
